create_logger_init: create a Logger instance initialized with args containing plot, plot_dir, plot_name, local_rank, and data_type
log_training_metrics: log training and validation metrics like loss and error rates per training step using the Logger step method
plot_line_chart: plot a line chart of scalar values to TensorBoard using the Logger plot_line method
plot_bar_chart: plot a bar chart of scalar values to TensorBoard using the Logger plot_bar method
plot_heatmap: plot a heatmap visualization of 2D data to TensorBoard using the Logger plot_heatmap method
